title: The sign-in card says only you can see the saved copy and that it holds workouts, routines and body weight, but MettleUp can look and it also holds your name, age, height and measurements
what: The Keep your workouts on MettleUp card says MettleUp saves your workouts, routines and body weight, that only you can see it, and that everything comes back on a new phone. The copy also sends your profile (name, age, height, goal, bio, link), measurements and own exercises; MettleUp staff can read it to fix faults (the privacy notice says so); and some things (settings, hidden exercises, photos) do not come back.
expected: The card names everything the copy sends, says MettleUp may look only to fix a fault as the privacy notice does, and does not say everything comes back.
how_often: every time a member reads the sign-in card
fix_line: Rewrite the card in the privacy notice words: what is saved, who may look, what stays on the phone

title: After a Drive restore that did not fully finish, the member is told to tap Restore again, but no button has that name
what: When a Google Drive backup is brought back but a small last step fails, the message says Tap Restore again to finish it. On the Backup and restore page the button is called Find my Drive backup, and tapping it runs the whole bring-back again.
expected: The message names the real button, or says the app finishes the step by itself on the next start (as the welcome screen already does).
how_often: rarely, only when a Drive restore half-finishes
fix_line: Change the words to name Find my Drive backup, or say it finishes on its own

title: If the coach comes back, its messages use technical words and call the offline coach by a name the settings page does not use
what: The coach tells members to add a Claude, OpenAI or Groq API key, and to switch to the built-in Local coach. The coach settings page calls that choice Local demo. A gym member does not know what an API key is.
expected: Plain words a member understands, and one name for the offline coach everywhere.
who: members, only if the coach is switched on
how_often: every coach error or offline reply
fix_line: Rewrite the coach help lines in member words before switching the coach on

items.reason: English only: the app language setting feeds only the switched-off coach, so there are no Hinglish screen words and no Hindi read-aloud list; no banned-word list was given, none checked
ways into the saved copy: the member's own rows, the server key and the database owner login; no gym or HQ screen reads it
every Settings path named in the words was matched to a real page title
the only greyed button for this area shows Working... while busy; this area holds no screens of its own
button text shrinks and wraps (flexShrink, no numberOfLines); no nowrap or min-width on the backup and account cards; English only
no picture, icon or image is referenced from the ai, backup or cloud folders (grep for png and require found none)
this area posts no notifications and holds no tap handler (grep for Notifications found none); the tap handler belongs to the notification areas
no notification is posted from the ai, backup or cloud folders
no save button in this area is greyed for nothing changed; the AI key fields are behind the coach switch

members are not promised that every look at their saved copy is recorded (the notice says MettleUp looks only to fix a fault), so no record is owed; the direct-read record (not live per its header) would show looks to gym owners only, never to the member
no every-look promise to members in this area, so the none-is-a-finding rule does not trigger
